//: Policy for this repo, read by .github/scripts/merge-gate.mjs. Strict JSON — that script JSON.parse()s it, so comments must be "//" keys, never // lines.
name: plenipo-agents

autonomy.//: level: 0 nothing · 1 docs+tests · 2 features on review · 3 unattended. Set by a human, never inferred — an agent deciding it has earned autonomy is the self-approving loop wearing a different hat.
autonomy.//set-by: A human set this to 3 in words on 2026-08-01, having been told the ladder's stated entry requirement ('level 2 clean over a stretch') was unmet: this repo had never merged autonomously at any level. Recorded here because that is the fact a future tick needs and the conversation is gone.
autonomy.//what-3-means-here: Level 3 permits unattended merges across the marketplace, including its verifier and workflow controls. Every merge needs an approval-specific artifact from the protected-base reviewer; control paths are also re-evaluated by pr-gates.mjs downloaded from main, so a PR cannot replace the wrapper or policy that judges itself.
autonomy.//unattended-merge: The owner explicitly requested no human intervention on 2026-08-10. The repository ruleset must require deterministic status checks but no approving review. agent-merge.yml uses the configured user PAT so label, branch-update and merge events trigger the next workflows instead of being suppressed as GITHUB_TOKEN events.
autonomy.//cloud-approver: pr-approval-verdict.md and agent-approval-reset.yml are installed as a pair. The label alone is never authority: merge-gate.mjs verifies the exact run's safe-output artifact, head, base and body revision before merging.
